notes.title: Gears Of War: E-Day devs People Can Fly cancel two game projects after falling out with unnamed publisher
notes.content:
Gears Of War: E-Day and Outriders developers People Can Fly are cancelling two video game projects and laying people off due to "a lack of communication" from one game's publisher, and "a lack of prospects for securing organizational resources and funds" for the other.

notes.title: People Can Fly Joins Co-Development of Gears of War: E-Day With The Coalition
notes.content:
On Sunday, People Can Fly posted an official announcement on its website stating it will help co-develop Gears of War: E-Day with The Coalition.

Aside from the official reveal of The Coalition’s next title, Gears of War: E-Day, and the notion that it will be a prequel, not much has been learned about the next Gears of War entry. That changed late Sunday, when People Can Fly announced it would sign on as a co-developer of the next entry in Gears of War alongside The Coalition.

People Can Fly is no stranger to the Gears of War franchise, having led development for the spin-off Gears of War: Judgment and helped co-develop the original Gears of War through Gears of War 3.

People Can Fly’s CEO Sebastian Wojciechowski said, “Returning to collaborate on the next chapter of this legendary saga is both a privilege and an exciting opportunity to build upon the intense, visceral action and rich storytelling that fans have come to love.... Read more
